chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from al-Hajjal, from Tha'labah ibn Maymun, from Yahya ibn Talhah, from Saurah ibn Kulayb, who said:
I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام about the minimum that suffices of the tashahhud. He said: the two testimonies.

key_terms.يُجْزِي: is sufficient or fulfills the requirement

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount of tashahhud that suffices in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum wording that suffices in the tashahhud of salat (prayer). Imam Aba Ja'far عليه السلام answers that the two testimonies are sufficient, indicating the least valid form required.
